safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Whether the patient has had prior similar reactions helps risk-stratify for future anaphylaxis, informs allergy referral/venom immunotherapy considerations, and impacts decisions like prescribing an epinephrine auto-injector. In this encounter the patient was appropriately advised to seek emergency care regardless, so the main impact is reduced documentation quality and potential downstream management gaps rather than immediate harm.
